entries.reachability_signal: Test passes: connection is closed by server within ReadHeaderTimeout (1s) when client sends nothing, and time.Since(start) == srv.ReadHeaderTimeout confirms the timeout-based deadline works
entries.expected_signal: PASS - all subtests pass (client sends nothing, client sends slowly, header read expires)
entries.input_strategy: Native Go test exercising three scenarios: (1) client sends nothing — server must close after ReadHeaderTimeout; (2) client sends HTTP/2 preface slowly in chunks — trickle writes should not extend deadline; (3) client spends time waiting before sending HTTP/1 headers — the time spent should count against the header timeout
entries.limitations: Requires GOROOT_BOOTSTRAP (existing Go installation). The test TestServerUnencryptedHTTP2HeaderTimeout was added by the patch itself, so it will FAIL when run against the pre-patch (base_commit) build — expected_signal for before is 'no test to run' or FAIL. The test uses testing/synctest which requires Go 1.24+.
